evidence_boundaries: The Benkadoum and Fairchild papers contain direct laser experiments; their double-Maxwellian, GEANT4, PrismSPECT, MERL and inferred temperature-density interpretations are model-assisted.

The Karavola and Agrawal studies are PIC-based numerical evidence, not experimental validation; the former uses an idealized pair plasma and the latter is restricted to two-dimensional electrostatic linear modes.
The Connor paper is a four-page tensor-network prototype without an equal-accuracy production-PIC cost comparison.
NeutronGym reports McStas and reinforcement-learning software experiments on fixed layouts, mostly with one training seed; it is not a facility demonstration.
No PIC, atomic-physics, radiation-transport, tensor-network, McStas or reinforcement-learning computation was performed locally.
